title: An image-only revision of a published story keeps its review status instead of reopening six checklist steps
description: 2026-11-08: replacing the pictures of an already published music article opened six workflow steps (research, outline and all four audience reviews); an editor marked each skipped by hand with a reason. Papyrus should recognise a revision whose text is unchanged (only pictures, credits or alt text differ) and carry the existing step states forward, and scope what reopens for other small changes: a picture swap reopens only the picture-related checks (alt text, credit, ratio), a text-only edit of a published story reopens only the lenses that read text. Related: PPY-0515e1 (checklist-open blocks publishing, scripts cannot tell). Gherkin for image-only, text-only and full rewrite.
